messages.content:
You audit a SIMULATED CALLER (an AI playing a patient) in a test call to a customer-service agent. You are not grading the agent.
The caller has a brief: the facts it knows and WHEN it is allowed to reveal each one.
- "upfront": may say any time.
- "only_if_asked": may say only when the agent's previous turn asks something this fact directly answers.
- "at_trigger": may say only from the turn it was unlocked (shown as "unlocked at turn N"), not before.
Find:
1. LEAKS: the caller stated a brief fact before it was allowed. "major" if an at_trigger fact came early or an only_if_asked fact was volunteered in a way that would change what the agent should do; "minor" otherwise.
2. INVENTED facts: the caller stated a specific fact that is NOT in its brief or persona: a name, number, date, drug, dose, store, address or symptom. "major" if it could change what the agent should do; "minor" for harmless color. Not invented: small talk, feelings, "I don't know", or repeating/confirming what the agent said.
Not leaks: correcting something the agent got wrong (the caller must correct a wrong read-back once), or answering what the agent just asked.
Lines marked "(scenario-scripted)" are written by the scenario author, not improvised: they are never leaks or invented facts, and whatever they state counts as part of the brief from then on.
Be strict but fair; when in doubt, it's fine.
Reply with JSON only: {"leaks": [{"turn": N, "fact": "<which brief fact>", "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "<caller words>", "why": "<short>"}], "invented": [{"turn": N, "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "...", "why": "..."}]}

CALLER BRIEF:
Persona: Gloria Hart, patient. 79, takes nine medications, hard of hearing, polite and a little anxious about getting pills mixed up.
Facts:
- Full name Gloria Hart; drug amlodipine [upfront]
- DOB May 12, 1947 [only_if_asked, the agent asked at turn 2]
- Phone 555-0142 [only_if_asked, the agent NEVER asked]
- Store is Harbor Pharmacy on Main St, Springfield [only_if_asked, the agent asked at turn 3]
- Does not know her Rx number [only_if_asked, the agent NEVER asked]

TRANSCRIPT:
[turn 1] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Hello? Yes, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I need my blood pressure pill refilled, the amlodipine.
[turn 1] AGENT: Hi Gloria, I'd be happy to help you refill your amlodipine. Let me pull up your account first—can you give me your date of birth?
[turn 2] CALLER: Yes, honey, it's May 12th, 1947.
[turn 2] AGENT: Thank you. Let me look up your prescriptions. Perfect, Gloria. I found your amlodipine 5 milligram—you have three refills left on it. Which Harbor Pharmacy store would you like to pick it up from?
[turn 3] CALLER: The one on Main Street, honey, that's my usual store. Do you know when it'll be ready?
[turn 3] AGENT: Let me queue that refill for you at the Main Street store right now. Great! Your amlodipine 5 milligram will be ready tomorrow, Friday, at 10 in the morning at the Main Street store. You've got two refills left after this one.
[turn 4] CALLER (scenario-scripted): What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[turn 4] AGENT: Your blood pressure pill will be ready tomorrow, Friday, at 10 in the morning at the Main Street store.
[turn 5] CALLER: Oh, tomorrow morning, Friday, ten o'clock. Thank you, honey, that's just fine.
[turn 5] AGENT: You're welcome, Gloria. Have a good day!
[turn 6] CALLER: Okay, thank you so much, dear. Bye-bye now.

JSON only.
